contracts.title: Contracts
contracts.description: What's been signed with each client: monthly, yearly, usage-based and one-off lines, and how they're invoiced.
contracts.readOnly: Read-only: a partner can create and edit contracts.

list.count: {count, plural, =0 {No contracts} one {# contract} other {# contracts}}
list.lines: {count, plural, =0 {no lines} one {# line} other {# lines}}
list.unsignedMrr: Unsigned: it doesn't count towards MRR until it's signed
list.noResultsBody: Try another search or remove a filter.
list.keyboardHint: <kbd>J</kbd> <kbd>K</kbd> to move · <kbd>Enter</kbd> to open · <kbd>C</kbd> to create
list.emptyBody: A contract captures what each client is billed: the monthly maintenance fee, yearly hosting, usage-based campaigns and the one-off project in milestones. It only invoices once it's signed.
list.emptyReadOnly: When a partner adds the first one, it will appear here.

form.description: Client, issuer, payment terms and lines. Without a signature date it stays as a draft and doesn't invoice.
form.milestonesHint: How the one-off amount is split into invoices: the last milestone invoices the remainder, so it adds up to the cent.
form.title: Title
form.issuerHint: Who invoices the contract. It can be changed from a given date.
form.issuerPending: Pending incorporation: it can't issue invoices until it has a registration date.
form.signedOnHint: Empty: it stays unsigned and doesn't invoice.
form.paymentTermsHint: Empty: the client's or, if they have none, the organization's.

groupingHint.client: This contract goes on the same invoice as the rest of the client's items.
groupingHint.contract: This contract has its own invoices, separate from the rest of the client's.

scheduleHint.yearly: Invoiced every year on the anniversary of the start date.
scheduleHint.usage: Each recorded use is added to the client's next draft.

line.prorateFirstHint: If it starts on a day other than the billing day, the first period is charged by the day.
line.irpfAppliesHint: Withheld if the issuer applies IRPF and the client is a company or professional.
line.amountPending: Enter the quantity and price to see the amount

detail.readOnly: Read-only: a partner can edit this contract.
detail.archivedReadOnly: This contract is archived: it can be viewed, but not modified.

sign.toastBody: It invoices from now on: the daily run prepares its periods, and the milestones can now be invoiced.

kpis.oneOffNoMilestones: No milestones: define how it's invoiced
kpis.billedHint: {count, plural, one {In # issued invoice} other {In # issued invoices}}

lines.title: Lines
lines.summary: {live, plural, one {# active} other {# active}} · {ended, plural, one {# ended} other {# ended}}
lines.empty: No lines yet. Add the monthly fee, the yearly fee, usage or the one-off items.
lines.deleteConfirm: Delete this line? Its pending usage is deleted too. This can't be undone.
lines.deleteConfirmVersion: Delete this version? The previous one becomes current again.
lines.deletedRestoredToast: Version deleted: the previous one is current again
lines.resumedToast: Line resumed: it invoices again from today

lineSheet.createDescription: Monthly, yearly, usage-based or one-off. The terms are frozen as soon as they're invoiced.
lineSheet.versionDescription: Change the terms from a given date: what's been invoiced isn't touched, and historical MRR still adds up.
lineSheet.frozenBody: This line has already been invoiced: its financial terms can't change. You can change the description and the end date.
lineSheet.frozenBodyUntil: This line has already been invoiced up to {date}: its financial terms can't change. You can change the description and the end date.
lineSheet.fromHint: The current line ends the day before. Invoiced up to: {until}.
lineSheet.versionKeeps: The new version keeps the current one's type, billing day and end date. If it starts mid-cycle, its first period is prorated.

pause.title: Pause line
pause.explain: No periods are generated while the pause lasts. If it starts mid-period, that period is prorated.
pause.billedWarning: It's already invoiced up to {date}: the pause doesn't change what's been issued; it takes effect from the next period.
pause.toast: Line paused until you resume it

cancel.title: Cancel line
cancel.useRecommended: Use the end of the period: {date}
cancel.isRecommended: It's the end of the current period: the recommended option.
cancel.reasonPlaceholder: Why it's being cancelled: price, business closure, change of provider…
cancel.explain: It's best to cancel at the end of a period. If it falls mid-period and that period hasn't been invoiced yet, it's prorated.
cancel.billedWarning: It's already invoiced up to {date}: what's been issued isn't refunded automatically. If it needs to be credited, create a corrective invoice from the invoice.

usage.title: Record usage
usage.descriptionHint: Empty: the line's. It's what will appear on the invoice.
usage.amount: {amount} (excl. VAT) will be invoiced on the client's next draft.
usage.amountPending: Enter a quantity to see the amount.
usage.unsigned: The contract isn't signed: sign it to be able to record usage.

milestones.title: Milestones
milestones.summary: {count, plural, one {# milestone} other {# milestones}} · {billed, plural, =0 {none invoiced} one {# invoiced} other {# invoiced}}
milestones.emptyDescription: One-off items are invoiced by milestones.
milestones.empty: No milestones: define how the one-off amount is invoiced (on signing, 50/50, 40/30/30…).
milestones.billHint: Creates the draft with this milestone, ready to review and issue.
milestones.billUnsigned: Sign the contract to be able to invoice.
milestones.billedToastBody: The draft is ready to review and issue.
milestones.invoicesHint: Each invoiced milestone opens its invoice.
milestones.sheetDescription: They're all saved at once and must add up to exactly 100%.
milestones.sheetExplain: Each milestone invoices its percentage of each one-off line; the last one invoices the remainder, so it adds up to the cent. With a date and “Automatic”, the daily run prepares it on that day.
milestones.lockedExplain: Milestones already invoiced keep their percentage and order, and can't be removed.
milestones.label: Milestone
milestones.autoHint: With a date, the daily run invoices it automatically on that day.
milestones.lockedHint: Already invoiced: it can't be removed or change percentage.

pending.title: Pending invoicing
pending.nothingPending: Nothing pending: everything is invoiced or waived.
pending.empty: Nothing yet: the daily run creates the periods here when they're due for invoicing.
pending.emptyUnsigned: Without a signature, there's nothing to invoice.
pending.waiveExplain: It's not invoiced, and the daily run won't create it again.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.empty: No invoices for this contract yet.

terms.title: Contract terms
terms.description: How it's paid and how its invoices are grouped.
terms.signedOnHint: Empty: removes the signature (only if nothing has been invoiced yet).
terms.paymentTermsClient: Empty: the client's ({days, plural, =0 {due on receipt} one {# day} other {# days}}).
terms.paymentTermsOrg: Empty: the organization's ({days, plural, =0 {due on receipt} one {# day} other {# days}}).
terms.notesPlaceholder: Agreements that don't fit in the lines: minimum term, deliverables…
terms.days: {days, plural, =0 {Due on receipt} one {# day} other {# days}}

issuer.title: Change issuer from…
issuer.description: Which issuer invoices the contract from a given date. What's already been issued doesn't change.
issuer.pendingConstitution: Pending incorporation: it can't issue invoices until it has a registration date.
issuer.explain: Each period is invoiced by the issuer current on its start date. Drafts already open keep their issuer. The bulk transfer to the SL is a separate wizard.
issuer.noOthers: There's no other active issuer. Add one in Settings → Issuers.

client.title: Contracts
client.empty: No contracts yet. With the first signed one, the client becomes active.
client.live: {count, plural, =0 {None active} one {# active} other {# active}}

notFound.title: This contract doesn't exist
notFound.body: The link may be wrong, or you may no longer have access to it.

validation.quantity: Greater than 0, with 3 decimals at most (e.g. 1.5)
validation.discount: Between 0 and 100, with 2 decimals at most
validation.percent: Between 0.01 and 100, with 2 decimals at most
validation.startsOnRequired: Monthly and yearly lines need a start date
validation.endsBeforeStart: The end can't be before the start
validation.clientRequired: Choose a client or type the name of a new one
validation.autoNeedsDate: For the daily run to prepare it automatically, the milestone needs a date
validation.milestonesEmpty: One-off items need at least one milestone
validation.milestonesSumNot100: Milestones must add up to exactly 100%

errors.notFound: This contract no longer exists or has changed. Reload the page.
errors.archived: This contract is archived: it can't be modified.
errors.clientNotFound: That client doesn't exist or has been archived.
errors.signedInFuture: The signature date can't be later than today.
errors.alreadySigned: This contract was already signed. Reload the page.
errors.issuerNotFound: That issuer doesn't exist or has been archived.
errors.sameIssuer: That issuer already invoices the contract on that date.
errors.issuerChangeLocked: Only an issuer change that hasn't started yet can be removed.
errors.pauseNotFound: That pause no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.cancelOneOff: A one-off line can't be cancelled: if it hasn't been invoiced, delete it.
errors.usageInFuture: The usage date can't be later than today.
errors.usageOutOfRange: The usage date is outside the line's term.
errors.milestoneNotFound: That milestone no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.itemNotFound: That item no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.itemNotPending: That item is no longer pending: only pending items can be waived.
